compatibility.summary: Merge preserves both local feature commits and concurrent main changes for site-group preselection and Android/Pi setup presentation. Server 0.29.9/player 0.15.5 retain existing sync and manifest contracts; new forecast cards require 0.15.5 for appearance, while older players fall back to Horizontal. Non-expiring keys, home groups, 100-row tables, fork skipping, parent slide grants and upload limits retain their prior reviewed semantics. Both parallel 0.29.7/0.15.4 changelog descriptions and engineering review records are preserved. All 267 Node, 101 Python and 38 Android JVM tests pass; SDK API-35 production compilation succeeds. Chromium verifies merged application/site creation, permanent keys, home modes/group filters and forecast publication/live rendering. Typecheck, lint and build pass. Local AMD64 container startup, SQLite/admin persistence, Sharp/WebP and FFmpeg pass. Signed APK publication and physical device acceptance are pending.
